dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: #*yawn* {NICKNAME}, you're so full of energy. Don't you ever need to rest?

choices.text: Did you enjoy your trip to Dragonspine, Sayu?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Mmm... if you don't count Sumire's training sessions, the work part was actually pretty relaxed.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Ah, forgot to tell you — Sumire's the new inspector. She was leading this Shuumatsuban mission to Dragonspine, and honestly... she kept a closer eye on me than any shrine maiden ever has...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Earlier, they sent some people to participate in some kind of war game simulation... to gain experience, I guess.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Then that representative named Kuromaro, returned with a bunch of reports. He got support from some higher-ups, and started contacting Hatamoto everywhere to roll out new training methods. Even the Shuumatsuban got swept up in it...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I don't really get all the details... but the Yoohoo Art isn't even suited for head-on combat! Why do they have to push me so hard...? It's pointless...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: The most I can do is teach their new Ninken, that little Gaumaru, how to hide better and nap anywhere, anytime.

choices.text: Oh... so they made you do extra training?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I've gotta thank Klee and Yaoyao for this...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: When we first got to Mondstadt, while handling paperwork at the Knights of Favonius, Klee got curious about the tail on my outfit and asked me a bunch of questions...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Then she invited me to this camp, where we found Yaoyao. After a couple rounds of hide-and-seek, we became friends.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: And Klee even has her own title — "Spark Knight"! Sounds pretty impressive, doesn't it?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: The intel says that anyone in the Knights of Favonius with a special title is basically captain-level. Even their Master's just called the "Lionfang Knight," so... I guess they're kind of on the same level?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: That means Klee's probably just as strong as their Master — and her words count just as much!

choices.text: W—Wait... Is that really how it works?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Anyway, that's how Sumire sees it. She totally respects Klee! The moment Klee said she wanted to play with me, Sumire didn't dare pull me away for training anymore!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: When I'm with Klee and Yaoyao, I feel really at ease.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: People always mistake me for being their age, but that's fine. I get more snacks and gifts, and that's a different kind of happiness...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: If only the boat ride here wasn't so long, and I could get enough sleep every day... maybe I'd visit Klee more often!

choices.text: Well... I mean... technically, that kinda makes sense..
But you don't seem busy right now, huh?
Is there anything else in Mondstadt that interests you?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Hmm... It's the bass in Cider Lake!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Mm-hmm. Klee showed me a photo of her mom — she's super tall!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: And usually, kids don't grow shorter than their parents, so that means Klee's gonna be tall too!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Klee said she loves the freshly-blasted bass from Cider Lake, and her mom likes it too. So that must mean the bass there is super good for you — and it probably helps you grow taller!

choices.text: That's easy. I can catch you a couple myself...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Really? Ah, you don't have to go through all that trouble!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Now that I think about it, buying freshly caught fish and grilling them the local way should be just as good, right? After all, even bass that's been blasted out of the lake still needs to be cooked properly before you can eat it...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I'll try it myself first!

choices.text: I happen to know a little about the "Klee-style fish blasting" method...
Is it because of Klee's taste?
You're right... I should go get some rest too.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Mm-hmm. You may not need to grow taller anymore, but getting more sleep is never a bad idea!
